name: Hayakawa Yuriko
source:
Year: 2nd year
Affiliation: Otowa Gakuen Festival Executive Committee
Likes: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wanko_soba]Wanko soba[/url], romance, tanbi (an old word used to describe yaoi)

[url=/c34895]Koichirou's[/url] childhood friend, [url=/c34897]Yuuki's[/url] kouhai and [url=/c34457]Mariko's[/url] younger sister. Yuriko is shy, but a very big daydreamer; she often gets nosebleeds from her delusions and also narrates them to others' dismay, as they happen to be often pretty ridiculous. To Yuriko, Koichiro, whom she calls "Hii-chan", is like a big brother; however, the misunderstanding that they are dating has never been cleaned up.
